crossRefs.note: There are, it may be, so many kinds of sounds in the world, and none of them is without meaning.

translations.web: There are, it may be, so many kinds of sounds in the world, and none of them is without meaning.
translations.bsb: Assuredly, there are many different languages in the world, yet none of them is without meaning.
translations.kjv: There are, it may be, so many kinds of voices in the world, and none of them is without signification.
translations.asv: There are, it may be, so many kinds of voices in the world, and no kind is without signification.
